title: OTel Span Receipt Verifier
description: Generates a per-span receipt chain over an OTLP/JSON trace (span digest, parent-span receipt digest, semconv_snapshot, eddsa-jcs-2022 signature over an ephemeral did:key) plus a Merkle-rooted (RFC 6962) trace receipt, then verifies any trace + receipt bundle: recomputes digests, walks the parent-receipt chain, rebuilds the Merkle root, and reports which spans are attested, unattested, or tampered. File export only, zero network egress. Zero PII.

trace.description: OTLP/JSON trace document (resourceSpans root), pasted or composed, never fetched

bundle.description: Span-receipt bundle produced by this tool (span_receipts[] + trace_receipt), to verify

trace_receipt.description: RFC 6962 Merkle root over span_receipts, plus OCG execution_hash and eddsa-jcs-2022 proof

verification_report.description: attested/unattested/tampered counts and per-span findings from a verify run

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_otel_span_receipt
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes per-span digests and the parent-receipt chain over an OTLP/JSON trace against a span-receipt bundle, rebuilds the RFC 6962 Merkle root, and reports which spans are attested, unattested, or tampered.

bundle.description: Span-receipt bundle (span_receipts[] + trace_receipt) to verify against the trace
